purpose: state readout coverage and label quality only; not controller transition training
episode_selection: Select independent official episode ranges using scene_info and ep_start_end_ids before inspecting state labels; no C/D; preserve root isolation
frames: 8 evenly spaced anchors per episode plus next frame, at most64 frames; never use 64-frame language window as skill boundary
before_download: Use parent-verified official ZIP64 offsets and ETag. Cache bounded229211511-byte central directory within total512MiB. Verify scene mapping, official episode boundaries and config first. On HTTP200 or mismatched Content-Range stop before reading body. Validate ZIP member name, CRC, compression ratio/size bounds and hashes. If scope exceeds cap, stop.
color_mapping: Check per-scene config order, URDF dimensions and RGB projections; do not blindly apply issue41 swap. Any ambiguity makes object labels unknown.
restoration: Compare original RGB/depth and scene/robot slots against restored renderer/geometry; record immediately after reset and one native physics tick; quantify per-object position/orientation, joints, RGB mismatch and contacts/forces. A reset is not a full physical snapshot.
labels: Keep same strict Holding/In definitions. No gripper-closed proxy; absent/unstable restored contacts do not prove original negative. Unknown mask for unsupported or unstable evidence; geometric In only where mapping, containment/support evidence and restore checks jointly suffice. No speculative thresholds frozen here.
split: Official episode is isolation key; selected pilot roots stay quarantine/evidence-only until data-label review. C/D remain excluded from training.
allowed_now: bounded official member retrieval and label-quality pilot authorized; none performed during this inventory
